entries.title: Proverbs 28:1
segments: ¶The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:2
segments: ¶For the transgression of a land many [are] the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding [and] knowledge the state [thereof] shall be prolonged. {by...: or, by men of understanding and wisdom shall they likewise be prolonged}

words.text: . {by...: or, by men of understanding and wisdom shall they likewise be prolonged}

entries.title: Proverbs 28:3
segments: ¶A poor man that oppresseth the poor [is like] a sweeping rain which leaveth no food. {which...: Heb. without food}

entries.title: Proverbs 28:4
segments: ¶They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:5
segments: ¶Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand all [things].

entries.title: Proverbs 28:6
segments: ¶Better [is] the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than [he that is] perverse [in his] ways, though he [be] rich.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:7
segments: ¶Whoso keepeth the law [is] a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous [men] shameth his father. {is a companion...: or, feedeth gluttons}

words.text: : but he that is a companion

entries.title: Proverbs 28:8
segments: ¶He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor. {unjust...: Heb. by increase}

words.text: it for him that will pity

entries.title: Proverbs 28:9
segments: ¶He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer [shall be] abomination.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:10
segments: ¶Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good [things] in possession.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:11
segments: ¶The rich man [is] wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out. {own...: Heb. eyes}

entries.title: Proverbs 28:12
segments: ¶When righteous [men] do rejoice, [there is] great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden. {hidden: or, sought for}

entries.title: Proverbs 28:13
segments: ¶He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh [them] shall have mercy.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:14
segments: ¶Happy [is] the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:15
segments: ¶[As] a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; [so is] a wicked ruler over the poor people.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:16
segments: ¶The prince that wanteth understanding [is] also a great oppressor: [but] he that hateth covetousness shall prolong [his] days.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:17
segments: ¶A man that doeth violence to the blood of [any] person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:18
segments: ¶Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but [he that is] perverse [in his] ways shall fall at once.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:19
segments: ¶He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain [persons] shall have poverty enough.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:20
segments: ¶A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent. {innocent: or, unpunished}

entries.title: Proverbs 28:21
segments: ¶To have respect of persons [is] not good: for for a piece of bread [that] man will transgress.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:22
segments: ¶He that hasteth to be rich [hath] an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him. {hasteth...: or, hath and evil eye hasteth to be rich}

words.text: upon him. {hasteth...: or, hath and evil eye hasteth to be rich}

entries.title: Proverbs 28:23
segments: ¶He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:24
segments: ¶Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, [It is] no transgression; the same [is] the companion of a destroyer. {a destroyer: Heb. a man destroying}

entries.title: Proverbs 28:25
segments: ¶He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be made fat.

words.text: : but he that putteth his trust

entries.title: Proverbs 28:26
segments: ¶He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:27
segments: ¶He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.

entries.title: Proverbs 28:28
segments: ¶When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
